factor_name: Volatility-scaled total overnight plus intraday reversal

calculation.description: Negative completed close-to-close move, decomposed into overnight gap and intraday return, divided by trailing 20-day close-return volatility. Higher values indicate larger completed losses relative to normal risk and predict stronger next-day cross-sectional returns.

validation.regime_notes: Above admission gates in 2020-2022 (IC 0.07205, ICIR 0.19766), 2023-2024 (0.05510, 0.15198), and 2025 through 2026-07-15 (0.05041, 0.13812). The short online slice 2026-07-16 through 2026-08-26 weakened materially but remains too short for deprecation; use damping and monitor drift.

signal_provenance.lookahead_control: signal uses completed OHLC bar and trailing volatility; forward return is next completed close-to-close return
signal_provenance.validation_method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation, at least 8 valid tradable instruments per date
